user.title: Set up Vienna Transport
user.description: Choose how to find the stop you want to monitor.

menu_option_descriptions.pick_line: Pick a line, its direction and a stop.
menu_option_descriptions.manual: Enter one or more RBL stop IDs directly.

pick_line.title: Find stop by line
pick_line.description: Pick the line of the stop you want to monitor.

pick_stop.title: Find stop by line
pick_stop.description: Pick the stop for line **{line}** towards **{towards}**.

manual.title: Set up Vienna Transport
manual.description: Enter the RBL stop IDs you want to monitor. You can find stop IDs via the [RBL search]({rbl_url}).

data_description.stop_ids: Add one stop ID per line, e.g., 4118

error.cannot_connect: Could not connect to the Wiener Linien API: {detail}. Check your internet connection and try again.
error.empty_stop_ids: No stop IDs entered. Enter at least one numeric stop ID.

error.invalid_stop_ids: The stop IDs {stop_ids} are invalid. Enter valid stop IDs.

error.stop_not_found: Some stop IDs were not found: {stop_ids}. Check the RBL ID.
error.unexpected_response: The Wiener Linien API returned an unexpected response: {detail}.
error.unknown: An unexpected error occurred. Check the Home Assistant logs for details.
